notes:
Summary: Mid-market PM/engineering org evaluating Redwood Hosted API for 6-week trial (Jan–Feb). Good dev velocity, now moving to Dedicated sizing. Trial produced useful telemetry but token-mix variability complicates capacity planning.

Highlights:
- Understood use: in-product conversational assistant + embeddings-backed search + reranking for product recommendations.
- Trial period: 2026-01-15 -> 2026-02-28. ~4.1M tokens ingested.
- Observed metrics: peak QPS 18, median QPS 3.8, sustained concurrency ~12 during peak hours. Token distribution (approx): 60% short (<=64 tokens), 30% medium (~256 tokens), 10% long (>=1024 tokens).
- Latency targets: p95 < 250ms for chat. Hosted p95 ~220ms on average, spikes to 350ms during the largest long-token batch.
- Cost sensitivity: high; engineering lead said “we need predictability — spikes are killing our margins.”

POC learnings and implications for Dedicated sizing:
- Much of cost comes from long-context rerank jobs. Suggest segregating rerank/embeddings onto separate pool or batch window.
- Recommended baseline Dedicated config (initial proposal): 3x A10G-like GPUs (base pool) with autoscale to 6 for peak bursts; node sizing tuned for medium-token mix. Expect sustained chat QPS ~90–130 (depending on batching) and burst capacity up to ~300 QPS if autoscale healthy.
- Token throughput estimate: ~1.2M tokens/hour sustained on base pool (medium-weight mix). Peak hourly tokens could reach 3.5M.
- Suggested routing policy: prefer dedicated pool for production chat; fallback to Hosted API for unexpected peaks (policy window 60s) until full Dedicated SLA approved.

Pricing conversation notes:
- Want commitment banding (reserved capacity) vs pay-as-you-go for bursts. Finance prefers a blended monthly commit with burst credits.
- Explored two commercial paths: 1) 12-month reserved 3-node plan + burst credits, 2) 6-month ramp with autoscaling and higher per-token rate for bursts.

Customer quotes / color: "Hosted trial showed promise but our traffic is spiky — predictable billing and SLOs are the blocker." — Head of Platform.

Artifacts: trial telemetry sheet (drive link), Fireflies calls w/ AE and SE, initial pricing deck v2.
